summary.text: Mike Nemes is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 38 since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Nemes served in the Kentucky House of Representatives, District 38, from 2011 to 2013, and took office in the Kentucky State Senate on January 28, 2020.
His professional experience includes work as a project coordinator in construction.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Senate Health and Welfare, Judiciary, Licensing and Occupations, and State and Local Government (chair) committees.
